description: Use when you need to screen a crypto wallet address or a person/company name against the official OFAC SDN sanctions list before paying or trading: exact address match (ETH, BTC, TRX, USDT and more as. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /sanctions/check, $0.005 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.

address.description: crypto address to screen (send this or name)

min_score.description: name matches only: lowest similarity score to report

name.description: person or entity name in Latin letters (transliterated), at least one word of 3+ characters (send this or address)

name: sanctions_screening
